references.when: The repository declares a self-contained Node ESM createAgent/runTurn function and explicitly selects the reference inventory.
The real agent needs an HTTP/process/framework adapter, installed dependencies or services beyond the reference inventory.
Library documentation is needed to resolve a specific integration question.
Source investigation, owner decisions or a custom integration contract are needed.
Build, repair, qualify or independently replay an integration and retain the handoff.
Author or validate discovery.json and integration-contract.json; canonical JSON Schema with discovery and contract definitions.
